guix_bootstrap.note: Subsequent derivation builds/substitutions are also included in the first root. Source/authentication cache was saved at job end.

local.source: Private source copy with generated/local state excluded; the primary checkout and index were preserved.

passes.cold: Fresh build/dependency/Go output directories with verified tool and package download caches available.
passes.warm: Same source and retained build/dependency outputs.
passes.fresh-checkout: Same retained outputs; source mtimes refreshed to approximate another checkout at the same mounted path.
passes.compiled-only: Compiled outputs and Go cache retained; installed dependencies moved aside and recreated through normal locked setup.

local.roles: Ordinary test with setup for all 11 examples, plus sanitizers and LTO for C/C++; these profiling commands are not a full CI rehearsal.

harness_failures_excluded.reason: Private source copy initially lacked Git metadata required by a standalone packaging test; 374 tests passed, one failed. Added a private empty Git commit, then all 375 passed.
Private source copy initially lacked Git metadata required by a standalone packaging test; 374 tests passed, one failed. Added a private empty Git commit, then all 375 passed.

rust_ci_without_miri.scope: Complete configured native Rust CI-stage checks with the pinned Miri toolchain hidden by a read-only empty bind mount; stable Rust, verified tools and package downloads retained; no native tool installation phase.

compression.method: Stream sorted tar output through Zstandard with four workers at levels 3 and 9, then decode and compare the complete tar stream SHA-256. Archives deleted after verification. Default window; no long-distance option.
compression.timing_limitations: Level 3 was measured first, with cold filesystem reads and concurrent profiling. Later reads were warm. Archive sizes and round-trip checks are useful; compression time differences are not a controlled speed comparison. First-read elapsed time on this host is especially sensitive to filesystem overhead; do not infer that level 9 is faster from the ordered trials.

cache_key_overlap.cause: Tool key includes root-qualified vcpkg pin inputs, even when the selected tool versions and directories are identical. Other aggregated caches also depend on selected roots.

persistent_local_inventory.note: Group counts identify repeated fingerprints, not safe deletion candidates. No persistent cache was deleted.

investigation_limits: Single exploratory observations on one shared Linux x64 host; no confidence intervals or cross-platform timing claims.
Warm package/tool stores were reused. Cold means project build/dependency outputs were absent, not an empty machine or an empty package download store.
The measured example output sample omits some CI coverage, lint, and release variants; use hosted logs for complete compressed working-set totals.
A single full-run working set is a lower bound for concurrent branches and different affected-root selections.
GitHub cache entries are immutable; pin-only build keys retain the first saved snapshot and do not refresh application outputs after code-only changes. Build systems still validate changed sources.
No new full GitHub run or deployment was performed. No persistent caches or managed Rust toolchain files were deleted.
follow_ups_in_priority_order: Retain download stores and C/C++/Rust/Go compiled outputs; evaluate excluding installed dependency trees from hosted archives while preserving local persistent installs.
Select native CI tools by executed phases so manual-only Miri is not installed in ordinary CI; retain its complete supported manual workflow.

Normalize identical tool identities, then consider per-tool archives to reuse exact verified installations across affected-root selections and native/Dev Container jobs. Keep trust, ABI, platform, architecture, filter and resource identities.
Investigate Guix channel history/authentication retention separately from application build caches; do not add entire Nix/Guix stores to the constrained Actions cache.
Add ownership-checked, locked, previewable local cache pruning with retained generations; do not infer inactive variants solely from age or root/environment grouping.

Consider narrow CMake GUI/documentation filtering only after measuring savings and verifying independent C/C++ workflows. Preserve compiler SDK contents and use rustup-supported components instead of deleting Rust-managed files.

cleanup.note: Logical file sizes sum entries and can count hardlinks more than once; this is not a measured filesystem free-space delta.
